name: Ansar Elements – News & Blog Theme Builder for Elementor
author: themeansar

sections.description:
Ansar Elements is a lightweight addon plugin for the Elementor page builder that adds additional widgets and elements to help users create modern and flexible page layouts.

The plugin integrates seamlessly with Elementor and does not require Elementor Pro. All widgets appear directly inside the Elementor editor under a dedicated category, making them easy to find and use.

Ansar Elements is designed to be beginner-friendly while still providing useful controls for advanced users. It follows WordPress and Elementor coding standards and is optimized for performance.

Features

  • Header Builder – Design custom headers for your news or blog site
  • Footer Builder – Create dynamic footers with full customization
  • Archive Builder – Build category, tag, and author archive pages
  • Single Post Builder – Custom templates for blog posts and news articles
  • Search Page Builder – Design your search results page layout
  • 404 Page Builder – Create custom error pages for your site
  • Responsive Design – Fully mobile-friendly and tablet-ready layouts
  • Lightweight & Performance Optimized – Loads scripts only when widgets are used
  • Works with Free Elementor – No Pro required
  • Compatible with Most WordPress Themes

Lightweight & Performance Focused

Ansar Elements is built with clean code and optimized asset loading. Scripts and styles are only loaded when required by active widgets.

FREE THEME BUILDER WIDGETS

âœ… Site Titl â€“ Show your site name with styling controls.
âœ… Navigation Menu â€“ Horizontal, vertical, or expandable menu styles.
âœ… Search Widget â€“ search with multiple layouts.
âœ… Copyright â€“ Dynamic copyright text with year auto-update

How to Use

  1. Install and activate the Ansar Elements plugin.
  2. Make sure the Elementor plugin is installed and activated.
  3. Go to Pages → Add New (or edit an existing page).
  4. Click on “Edit with Elementor”.
  5. Find the “Ansar Elements” widgets in the Elementor panel.
  6. Drag a widget into your layout and customize it using the available settings.

Why Choose Ansar Elements

Unlike generic Elementor addons that focus only on widgets, Ansar Elements is purpose-built for news, magazine, and blog websites. It combines theme-building tools with editorial-specific layouts, letting you create a professional news portal without Elementor Pro.

Lightweight, performance-focused, and beginner-friendly, it’s the perfect solution for bloggers, publishers, and online magazine creators.
sections.faq:
Does this work with Elementor free version?

Yes. Ansar Elements works perfectly with the free version of Elementor. Elementor Pro is not required.

Do you provide support?

Yes. Support is provided through the WordPress.org support forums for free users.

Will it work with my theme?

Ansar Elements works with most modern themes that support Elementor.
